title: FHM2D Extract / Repack
intro: Handle one archive at a time: unpack a .fhm2d into a named folder plus its sibling structure JSON, or pack an already extracted folder back using that JSON.
sourceDescription: Unpacked by the Rust extract_fhm2d_to_folder command, not by the JS parser used for the preview.
destinationDescription: Files land here; the structure JSON is written beside the folder.
nameDescription: Used for the output folder and the sibling structure JSON name.
nameDescriptionNoSubfolder: Subfolder creation is off, so the selected output folder name becomes Name.
createSubfolderHelp: Writes into output/name/ and name_structure.json beside it.
namingDescription: Picks the rename pipeline the extractor applies to inner files.
writeMetaHelp: Handled by the Rust extractor when supported for this archive.
extractedDescription: The parent directory is searched for {folder}_structure.json (or legacy {folder}.json carrying SubFileStructure), then the folder is packed through repack_fhm2d.
resolvedDescription: Structure path and HashName-aware output written next to the folder.
chooseFolder: Choose an extracted folder to resolve its structure JSON.
looking: Looking for structure JSON in the parent directory...
missingMetadata: Structure JSON has no Name and/or HashName. Output falls back to the structure file stem instead of a hash-based name.
invalidMagic: The file magic is not a supported FHM2D archive.

formats.genericDescription: Extract files as-is without asset-type renames.
formats.characterDescription: Full unit package naming (numdlb groups, materials, textures).
formats.effectDescription: Effect package layout (lighter naming than character).
formats.strikerDescription: Host unit → striker slot table (0xFEEB79F0, vgsht1 stride 8).

archivePreview.title: Archive preview
archivePreview.description: Read-only JS parse of the selected .fhm2d. Unpack still uses the Rust extractor.
archivePreview.idle: Select an FHM2D file to inspect its header and structure.
